source.stem:
Multiple choice questions.

System of equations

$$
\left\{ \begin{array}{l} 3 x + 4 y = 5, \\ - 7 x + 9 y = - \frac {5}{2} \end{array} \right.
$$

The solution is ( ).

(A) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = 2,\\ y = -0.25 \end{array} \right.$

(B) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = -5.5,\\ y = 4 \end{array} \right.$

(C) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = 1,\\ y = 0.5 \end{array} \right.$

(D) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = -1,\\ y = -0.5 \end{array} \right.$

mx.name: operation_confusion
mx.teacher_note: Whole quantity is found by dividing the given values instead of multiplying, giving 57 as the reported result — on the item about Decide how to divide a whole quantity into several.

intelligence.enrichment: To divide a quantity x in the ratio a:b:c:..., first add the ratio terms, then give each part x times its term divided by the sum of all terms.
